If the quorums are\n// genuinely disjoint, both operations complete and the run reports the\n// intersection violation end-to-end.\nfunc SafetyWitness(nodes []SimNode, rq, wq int, kind string, quorumA, quorumB []string, failedDomains []string) RunInput {\n\tsetA := map[string]bool{}\n\tsetB := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, id := range quorumA {\n\t\tsetA[id] = true\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range quorumB {\n\t\tsetB[id] = true\n\t}\n\n\tvar rules []Rule\n\t// A-side traffic reaches only A's quorum nodes (both directions).\n\tfor id := range setA {\n\t\trules = append(rules,\n\t\t\tRule{Role: \"A\", To: id, MsgType: \"request\", Action: \"deliver\", Delay: 1},\n\t\t\tRule{Role: \"A\", From: id, MsgType: \"response\", Action: \"deliver\", Delay: 1},\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\tfor id := range setB {\n\t\trules = append(rules,\n\t\t\tRule{Role: \"B\", To: id, MsgType: \"request\", Action: \"deliver\", Delay: 1},\n\t\t\tRule{Role: \"B\", From: id, MsgType: \"response\", Action: \"deliver\", Delay: 1},\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\t// Everything else for A/B (requests to outside nodes, their responses) is\n\t// dropped; later attempts stay dropped too, but the first attempt already\n\t// completes once a quorum replies.\n\trules = append(rules,\n\t\tRule{Role: \"A\", MsgType: \"request\", Action: \"drop\"},\n\t\tRule{Role: \"A\", MsgType: \"response\", Action: \"drop\"},\n\t\tRule{Role: \"B\", MsgType: \"request\", Action: \"drop\"},\n\t\tRule{Role: \"B\", MsgType: \"response\", Action: \"drop\"},\n\t\tRule{Action: \"deliver\", Delay: 1},\n\t)\n\n\topKind := \"ww\"\n\tif kind == \"rw\" {\n\t\topKind = \"rw\"\n\t}\n\treturn RunInput{\n\t\tNodes:       nodes,\n\t\tReadQuorum:  rq,\n\t\tWriteQuorum: wq,\n\t\tSim: Sim{\n\t\t\tSeed:          1,\n\t\t\tRuns:          1,\n\t\t\tHorizon:       30,\n\t\t\tClientTimeout: 100, // no retransmission noise during the witness\n\t\t\tMaxAttempts:   1,\n\t\t\tOperations:    2,\n\t\t\tKind:          opKind,\n\t\t\tFailedDomains: failedDomains,\n\t\t\tRules:         rules,\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// AvailabilityWitness builds a scripted run in which the network is perfect\n// but the given failure domains are down. No operation can complete, proving\n// the availability failure is caused by the outage rather than packet loss.\nfunc AvailabilityWitness(nodes []SimNode, rq, wq int, kind string, failedDomains []string) RunInput {\n\topKind := kind\n\tif opKind == \"\" {\n\t\topKind = \"ww\"\n\t}\n\treturn RunInput{\n\t\tNodes:       nodes,\n\t\tReadQuorum:  rq,\n\t\tWriteQuorum: wq,\n\t\tSim: Sim{\n\t\t\tSeed:          1,\n\t\t\tRuns:          1,\n\t\t\tHorizon:       30,\n\t\t\tClientTimeout: 100,\n\t\t\tMaxAttempts:   1,\n\t\t\tOperations:    1,\n\t\t\tKind:          opKind,\n\t\t\tFailedDomains: failedDomains,\n\t\t\tRules:         []Rule{{Action: \"deliver\", Delay: 1}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":52,"oldLines":7,"newStart":52,"newLines":7,"lines":["       Seed:          1,","       Runs:          1,","       Horizon:       30,","-      ClientTimeout: 100, // no retransmission noise during the witness","+      ClientTimeout: 1000, // beyond horizon: witness must not retransmit","       MaxAttempts:   1,","       Operations:    2,","       Kind:          opKind,"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"939a04d6-3256-488f-99e4-0ea0200135a2","session_id":"0bf00228-5acf-4f43-b1de-a9ac941c6425","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp29/b","sessionId":"0bf00228-5acf-4f43-b1de-a9ac941c6425","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp29-b","slug":"polymorphic-zooming-blanket"}

later attempts stay dropped too, but the first attempt already\n\t// completes once a quorum replies.\n\trules = append(rules,\n\t\tRule{Role: \"A\", MsgType: \"request\", Action: \"drop\"},\n\t\tRule{Role: \"A\", MsgType: \"response\", Action: \"drop\"},\n\t\tRule{Role: \"B\", MsgType: \"request\", Action: \"drop\"},\n\t\tRule{Role: \"B\", MsgType: \"response\", Action: \"drop\"},\n\t\tRule{Action: \"deliver\", Delay: 1},\n\t)\n\n\topKind := \"ww\"\n\tif kind == \"rw\" {\n\t\topKind = \"rw\"\n\t}\n\treturn RunInput{\n\t\tNodes:       nodes,\n\t\tReadQuorum:  rq,\n\t\tWriteQuorum: wq,\n\t\tSim: Sim{\n\t\t\tSeed:          1,\n\t\t\tRuns:          1,\n\t\t\tHorizon:       30,\n\t\t\tClientTimeout: 1000, // beyond horizon: witness must not retransmit\n\t\t\tMaxAttempts:   1,\n\t\t\tOperations:    2,\n\t\t\tKind:          opKind,\n\t\t\tFailedDomains: failedDomains,\n\t\t\tRules:         rules,\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\n// AvailabilityWitness builds a scripted run in which the network is perfect\n// but the given failure domains are down. No operation can complete, proving\n// the availability failure is caused by the outage rather than packet loss.\nfunc AvailabilityWitness(nodes []SimNode, rq, wq int, kind string, failedDomains []string) RunInput {\n\topKind := kind\n\tif opKind == \"\" {\n\t\topKind = \"ww\"\n\t}\n\treturn RunInput{\n\t\tNodes:       nodes,\n\t\tReadQuorum:  rq,\n\t\tWriteQuorum: wq,\n\t\tSim: Sim{\n\t\t\tSeed:          1,\n\t\t\tRuns:          1,\n\t\t\tHorizon:       30,\n\t\t\tClientTimeout: 100,\n\t\t\tMaxAttempts:   1,\n\t\t\tOperations:    1,\n\t\t\tKind:          opKind,\n\t\t\tFailedDomains: failedDomains,\n\t\t\tRules:         []Rule{{Action: \"deliver\", Delay: 1}},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":78,"oldLines":7,"newStart":78,"newLines":7,"lines":["       Seed:          1,","       Runs:          1,","       Horizon:       30,","-      ClientTimeout: 100,","+      ClientTimeout: 1000,","       MaxAttempts:   1,","       Operations:    1,","       Kind:          opKind,"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c35be25c-bd8b-4839-b847-3c0224aa1df2","session_id":"0bf00228-5acf-4f43-b1de-a9ac941c6425","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp29/b","sessionId":"0bf00228-5acf-4f43-b1de-a9ac941c6425","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp29-b","slug":"polymorphic-zooming-blanket"}

Weight must be non-negative. Domain groups\n// nodes that fail together (rack, AZ, ...).\ntype Node struct {\n\tID     string `json:\"id\"`\n\tWeight int    `json:\"weight\"`\n\tDomain string `json:\"domain\"`\n}\n\n// Config is a weighted quorum configuration. ReadQuorum / WriteQuorum are\n// integer weight thresholds; a quorum is any node subset whose total weight\n// reaches the threshold.\ntype Config struct {\n\tNodes           []Node `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tReadQuorum      int    `json:\"read_quorum\"`\n\tWriteQuorum     int    `json:\"write_quorum\"`\n\tTolerateDomains int    `json:\"tolerate_domains,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Warning describes a non-fatal configuration issue.\ntype Warning struct {\n\tCode    string `json:\"code\"`\n\tMessage string `json:\"message\"`\n}\n\n// Counterexample is a pair of quorums (within one failure scenario) that do\n// not intersect. Kind is \"ww\" (two write quorums) or \"rw\" (read and a write\n// quorum).\ntype Counterexample struct {\n\tKind        string   `json:\"kind\"`\n\tQuorumA     []string `json:\"quorum_a\"`\n\tWeightA     int      `json:\"weight_a\"`\n\tQuorumB     []string `json:\"quorum_b\"`\n\tWeightB     int      `json:\"weight_b\"`\n\t// FailedDomains is the failure scenario in which the pair is reachable\n\t// (empty for the no-failure scenario).\n\tFailedDomains []string `json:\"failed_domains,omitempty\"`\n\tExplanation   string   `json:\"explanation\"`\n\n\t// Witness is attached by callers (the simulator) and is never populated\n\t// by this package.\n\tWitness any `json:\"witness,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Scenario describes one concrete set of failed domains: what survives and\n// whether quorums remain possible and mutually intersecting.\ntype Scenario struct {\n\tFailedDomains   []string     `json:\"failed_domains\"`\n\tSurvivors       []string     `json:\"survivors\"`\n\tSurvivorWeight  int          `json:\"survivor_weight\"`\n\tReadPossible    bool         `json:\"read_possible\"`\n\tWritePossible   bool         `json:\"write_possible\"`\n\tNumReadQuorums  int          `json:\"num_read_quorums\"`\n\tNumWriteQuorums int          `json:\"num_write_quorums\"`\n\tReadQuorums     [][]string   `json:\"read_quorums,omitempty\"`\n\tWriteQuorums    [][]string   `json:\"write_quorums,omitempty\"`\n\tWWSafe          bool         `json:\"ww_safe\"`\n\tRWSafe          bool         `json:\"rw_safe\"`\n\tCounterexample  *Counterexample `json:\"counterexample,omitempty\"`\n\t// BeyondTolerance marks scenarios with more failed domains than the\n\t// configured tolerance (e.g. the all-domains-down scenario); they are\n\t// reported for reference and do not affect the availability verdict.\n\tBeyondTolerance bool `json:\"beyond_tolerance,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Report is the full result of validating and analysing a configuration.\ntype Report struct {\n\tValid  bool     `json:\"valid\"`\n\tErrors []string `json:\"errors,omitempty\"`\n\n\tWarnings []Warning `json:\"warnings,omitempty\"`\n\n\tNodes        []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tDomains      []string `json:\"domains\"`\n\tNumNodes     int      `json:\"num_nodes\"`\n\tNumDomains   int      `json:\"num_domains\"`\n\tTotalWeight  int      `json:\"total_weight\"`\n\tReadQuorum   int      `json:\"read_quorum\"`\n\tWriteQuorum  int      `json:\"write_quorum\"`\n\tExhaustive   bool     `json:\"exhaustive\"`\n\tExhaustiveLimit int   `json:\"exhaustive_limit\"`\n\n\t// Quorum sets of the no-failure scenario (capped listings; counts are\n\t// exact even when the listing is capped).\n\tNumReadQuorums  int        `json:\"num_read_quorums\"`\n\tNumWriteQuorums int        `json:\"num_write_quorums\"`\n\tReadQuorums     [][]string `json:\"read_quorums,omitempty\"`\n\tWriteQuorums    [][]string `json:\"write_quorums,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// Aggregate safety over every enumerated failure scenario.\n\tWWSafe bool `json:\"ww_safe\"`\n\tRWSafe bool `json:\"rw_safe\"`\n\n\t// Minimal counterexamples (fewest participating nodes, then least\n\t// weight, then lexicographic).\n\tMinimalWWCounterexample *Counterexample `json:\"minimal_ww_counterexample,omitempty\"`\n\tMinimalRWCounterexample *Counterexample `json:\"minimal_rw_counterexample,omitempty\"`\n\tMinimalCounterexample   *Counterexample `json:\"minimal_counterexample,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// Availability under up to TolerateDomains whole-domain outages.\n\tTolerateDomains             int      `json:\"tolerate_domains\"`\n\tNumScenarios                int      `json:\"num_scenarios\"`\n\tScenarioListTruncated       bool     `json:\"scenario_list_truncated,omitempty\"`\n\tAvailable                   bool     `json:\"available\"`\n\tMinimalAvailabilityFailure  []string `json:\"minimal_availability_failure,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// Enumerated scenarios (failing scenarios always; others capped).\n\tScenarios []Scenario `json:\"scenarios,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// MaxNodes is the largest configuration analysed by exhaustive mask\n// enumeration. 2^20 masks keeps memory/time bounded (~1 MiB per uint8 array).\nconst MaxNodes = 20\n\n// Listing caps.\nconst (\n\tmaxListedSets      = 64\n\tmaxListedScenarios = 64\n\tmaxHealthyScenarios = 30\n\tmaxScenarios       = 200000\n)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":111,"oldLines":6,"newStart":111,"newLines":7,"lines":["   ScenarioListTruncated       bool     `json:\"scenario_list_truncated,omitempty\"`","   Available                   bool     `json:\"available\"`","   MinimalAvailabilityFailure  []string `json:\"minimal_availability_failure,omitempty\"`","+  AvailabilityWitness         any      `json:\"availability_witness,omitempty\"`"," ","   // Enumerated scenarios (failing scenarios always; err != nil {\n\t\t// Invalid requests are distinguished from tool failures.\n\t\tif ce, ok := err.(*clientError); ok {\n\t\t\twriteJSON(os.Stdout, map[string]any{\"ok\": false, \"errors\": ce.errors})\n\t\t\tos.Exit(2)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"error:\", err)\n\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t}\n}\n\ntype clientError struct {\n\terrors []string\n}\n\nfunc (e *clientError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf(\"invalid request: %v\", e.errors) }\n\nfunc run(args []string, in io.Reader, out io.Writer) error {\n\taction := \"\"\n\tif len(args) > 0 {\n\t\taction = args[0]\n\t\tswitch action {\n\t\tcase \"analyze\", \"simulate\", \"all\":\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"unknown action %q (want analyze, simulate or all)\", action)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\traw, err := io.ReadAll(in)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tvar req request\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &req); err != nil {\n\t\treturn &clientError{errors: []string{fmt.Sprintf(\"invalid JSON: %v\", err)}}\n\t}\n\tif action == \"\" {\n\t\tif req.Action != \"\" {\n\t\t\taction = req.Action\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\taction = \"all\"\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Every action needs a valid config.\n\treport := quorum.Analyze(req.Config)\n\tif !report.Valid {\n\t\treturn &clientError{errors: report.Errors}\n\t}\n\n\tresult := map[string]any{\n\t\t\"ok\":      true,\n\t\t\"action\":  action,\n\t\t\"report\":  report,\n\t}\n\n\tif action == \"simulate\" {\n\t\tif req.Sim == nil {\n\t\t\treturn &clientError{errors: []string{\"simulate action requires a \\\"sim\\\" section\"}}\n\t\t}\n\t\tsimRep := sim.Run(toSimInput(req.Config, req.Sim))\n\t\tresult[\"simulation\"] = simRep\n\t\twriteJSON(out, result)\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tattachWitnesses(report, req.Config)\n\n\tif action == \"all\" && req.Sim != nil {\n\t\tresult[\"simulation\"] = sim.Run(toSimInput(req.Config, req.Sim))\n\t} else if action == \"all\" {\n\t\t// Default stochastic characterisation: perfect network must complete\n\t\t// every operation; it is a cheap sanity cross-check of the analyzer.\n\t\tdef := &sim.Sim{\n\t\t\tSeed: 42, Runs: 8, Kind: \"mixed\", Operations: 4,\n\t\t\tHorizon: 100, ClientTimeout: 15, MaxAttempts: 6,\n\t\t\tNetwork: &sim.Network{LossRate: 0, DuplicateRate: 0, MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 2},\n\t\t}\n\t\tresult[\"simulation\"] = sim.Run(toSimInput(req.Config, def))\n\t}\n\n\twriteJSON(out, result)\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// attachWitnesses replays every analyzer counterexample in the simulator and\n// stores the scripted input and run result on the counterexample.\nfunc attachWitnesses(report *quorum.Report, cfg quorum.Config) {\n\tnodes := make([]sim.SimNode, len(cfg.Nodes))\n\tfor i, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\tnodes[i] = sim.SimNode{ID: n.ID, Weight: n.Weight, Domain: n.Domain}\n\t}\n\tattach := func(ce *quorum.Counterexample) {\n\t\tif ce == nil || ce.Witness != nil {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tin := sim.SafetyWitness(nodes, cfg.ReadQuorum, cfg.WriteQuorum, ce.Kind, ce.QuorumA, ce.QuorumB, ce.FailedDomains)\n\t\trep := sim.Run(in)\n\t\tce.Witness = map[string]any{\"input\": in, \"result\": rep}\n\t}\n\tattach(report.MinimalWWCounterexample)\n\tattach(report.MinimalRWCounterexample)\n\n\tif !report.Available && len(report.MinimalAvailabilityFailure) > 0 {\n\t\tin := sim.AvailabilityWitness(nodes, cfg.ReadQuorum, cfg.WriteQuorum, \"ww\", report.MinimalAvailabilityFailure)\n\t\trep := sim.Run(in)\n\t\t// Surface as an extra pseudo-counterexample-free field via scenarios is\n\t\t// not possible; {"parentUuid":"f115c436-6619-4d18-91c1-a277a0a57209","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_mwoc6xjwlier68h6hqyxe22y","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp29/b/internal/quorum/masks_test.go","content":"package quorum\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/bits\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// bruteSafety is the reference implementation: enumerate every subset pair by\n// brute force and test disjointness directly. O(4^n) — only used on small\n// inputs as the oracle for the DP-based implementation.\nfunc bruteSafety(weights []int, rq, wq int) (wwSafe, rwSafe bool) {\n\tn := len(weights)\n\tsize := 1 << n\n\tw := make([]int, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tbit := m & -m\n\t\tw[m] = w[m^bit] + weights[bits.TrailingZeros(uint(bit))]\n\t}\n\tisW := func(m uint32) bool { return w[m] >= wq }\n\tisR := func(m uint32) bool { return w[m] >= rq }\n\twwSafe, rwSafe = true, true\n\tfor a := 1; a < size; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := 1; b < size; b++ {\n\t\t\tif uint32(a)&uint32(b) != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif isW(uint32(a)) && isW(uint32(b)) {\n\t\t\t\twwSafe = false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif isR(uint32(a)) && isW(uint32(b)) {\n\t\t\t\trwSafe = false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn\n}\n\n// bruteMinPair returns the minimum disjoint pair by the same ordering key,\n// found by plain enumeration.\nfunc bruteMinPair(weights []int, ta, tb int) (pair, bool) {\n\tn := len(weights)\n\tsize := 1 << n\n\tw := make([]int, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tbit := m & -m\n\t\tw[m] = w[m^bit] + weights[bits.TrailingZeros(uint(bit))]\n\t}\n\tidx := &quorumIndex{weight: w, n: n}\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tfor a := 1; a < size; a++ {\n\t\tif w[a] < ta {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor b := 1; b < size; b++ {\n\t\t\tif w[b] < tb || uint32(a)&uint32(b) != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcand := pair{uint32(a), uint32(b)}\n\t\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\nfunc TestDPMatchesBruteForce(t *testing.T) {\n\tweightsSet := [][]int{\n\t\t{1, 1, 1},\n\t\t{3, 2, 1},\n\t\t{1, 0, 2},\n\t\t{0, 0, 0},\n\t\t{5, 1, 1, 1},\n\t\t{2, 2, 2, 2},\n\t\t{1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1},\n\t\t{0, 3, 0, 3},\n\t\t{7, 1, 4, 2, 6},\n\t}\n\tfor _, weights := range weightsSet {\n\t\ttotal := 0\n\t\tfor _, x := range weights {\n\t\t\ttotal += x\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor rq := 1; O(4^n) — only used on small\n// inputs as the oracle for the DP-based implementation.\nfunc bruteSafety(weights []int, rq, wq int) (wwSafe, rwSafe bool) {\n\tn := len(weights)\n\tsize := 1 << n\n\tw := make([]int, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tbit := m & -m\n\t\tw[m] = w[m^bit] + weights[bits.TrailingZeros(uint(bit))]\n\t}\n\tisW := func(m uint32) bool { return w[m] >= wq }\n\tisR := func(m uint32) bool { return w[m] >= rq }\n\twwSafe, rwSafe = true, true\n\tfor a := 1; a < size; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := 1; b < size; b++ {\n\t\t\tif uint32(a)&uint32(b) != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif isW(uint32(a)) && isW(uint32(b)) {\n\t\t\t\twwSafe = false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif isR(uint32(a)) && isW(uint32(b)) {\n\t\t\t\trwSafe = false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn\n}\n\n// bruteMinPair returns the minimum disjoint pair by the same ordering key,\n// found by plain enumeration.\nfunc bruteMinPair(weights []int, ta, tb int) (pair, bool) {\n\tn := len(weights)\n\tsize := 1 << n\n\tw := make([]int, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tbit := m & -m\n\t\tw[m] = w[m^bit] + weights[bits.TrailingZeros(uint(bit))]\n\t}\n\tidx := &quorumIndex{weight: w, n: n}\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tfor a := 1; a < size; a++ {\n\t\tif w[a] < ta {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor b := 1; b < size; b++ {\n\t\t\tif w[b] < tb || uint32(a)&uint32(b) != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcand := pair{uint32(a), uint32(b)}\n\t\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\nfunc TestDPMatchesBruteForce(t *testing.T) {\n\tweightsSet := [][]int{\n\t\t{1, 1, 1},\n\t\t{3, 2, 1},\n\t\t{1, 0, 2},\n\t\t{0, 0, 0},\n\t\t{5, 1, 1, 1},\n\t\t{2, 2, 2, 2},\n\t\t{1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1},\n\t\t{0, 3, 0, 3},\n\t\t{7, 1, 4, 2, 6},\n\t}\n\tfor _, weights := range weightsSet {\n\t\ttotal := 0\n\t\tfor _, x := range weights {\n\t\t\ttotal += x\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor rq := 1; ok {\n\t\t\t\t\tgotRW = false\n\t\t\t\t\twant, okB := bruteMinPair(weights, rq, wq)\n\t\t\t\t\tif !okB || p != want {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"weights=%v rq=%d wq=%d min RW pair: got %v want %v\", weights, rq, wq, p, want)\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\twantWW, wantRW := bruteSafety(weights, rq, wq)\n\t\t\t\tif gotWW != wantWW || gotRW != wantRW {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"weights=%v rq=%d wq=%d: DP safety=(%v,%v) brute=(%v,%v)\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tweights, rq, wq, gotWW, gotRW, wantWW, wantRW)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestRandomCrossCheck exhaustively cross-validates the DP against brute force\n// over thousands of random weight/threshold combinations (small n only).\nfunc TestRandomCrossCheck(t *testing.T) {\n\trng := newTestRNG(0xC0FFEE)\n\tfor iter := 0; The exact total count of\n// canonical quorums is returned alongside.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) listQuorums(threshold int) (masks []uint32, total int) {\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] < threshold || idx.hasZeroWeightMember(uint32(m)) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ttotal++\n\t\tif len(masks) < maxListedSets {\n\t\t\tmasks = append(masks, uint32(m))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(masks, func(i, j int) bool { return quorumLess(masks[i], masks[j], idx.weight) })\n\tif total > maxListedSets {\n\t\tmasks = masks[:maxListedSets]\n\t}\n\treturn masks, total\n}\n\n// zeroMask records which indices carry zero weight; populated lazily.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) hasZeroWeightMember(m uint32) bool {\n\tif idx.zeroMask == 0 {\n\t\tfor i, w := range idx.weights {\n\t\t\tif i < 32 && w == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tidx.zeroMask |= 1 << uint(i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn m&idx.zeroMask != 0\n}"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e2e223d09c43f89ba6e8f167","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":493,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":78648,"output_tokens":1146,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_i55q383cj1aie63o8on61ar0":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp29/b/internal/sim/../quorum/masks.go","new_string":"// listQuorums returns canonical quorum masks reaching threshold, ordered by\n// key, capped at maxListedSets. The exact total count is returned alongside.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) listQuorums(threshold int) (masks []uint32, total int) {\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] >= threshold {\n\t\t\ttotal++\n\t\t\tif len(masks) < maxListedSets {\n\t\t\t\tmasks = append(masks, uint32(m))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(masks, func(i, j int) bool { return quorumLess(masks[i], masks[j], idx.weight) })\n\tif total > maxListedSets {\n\t\tmasks = masks[:maxListedSets]\n\t}\n\treturn masks, total\n}","newString":"// listQuorums returns canonical quorum masks reaching threshold, ordered by\n// key, capped at maxListedSets. A zero-weight node is never part of a\n// canonical quorum: it contributes nothing and would only create duplicate\n// representations of the same reaching set. The exact total count of\n// canonical quorums is returned alongside.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) listQuorums(threshold int) (masks []uint32, total int) {\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] < threshold || idx.hasZeroWeightMember(uint32(m)) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ttotal++\n\t\tif len(masks) < maxListedSets {\n\t\t\tmasks = append(masks, uint32(m))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(masks, func(i, j int) bool { return quorumLess(masks[i], masks[j], idx.weight) })\n\tif total > maxListedSets {\n\t\tmasks = masks[:maxListedSets]\n\t}\n\treturn masks, total\n}\n\n// zeroMask records which indices carry zero weight; populated lazily.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) hasZeroWeightMember(m uint32) bool {\n\tif idx.zeroMask == 0 {\n\t\tfor i, w := range idx.weights {\n\t\t\tif i < 32 && w == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tidx.zeroMask |= 1 << uint(i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn m&idx.zeroMask != 0\n}","originalFile":"package quorum\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/bits\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// quorumIndex holds precomputed subset tables over the full node universe.\n//\n// Because all weights are non-negative (enforced by Validate), \"subset X\n// contains a quorum of threshold T\" is simply weight[X] >= T: if any subset\n// of X reaches T then X does too. The interesting question is whether two\n// *disjoint* quorums exist, which is answered with a subset-minimum DP.\ntype quorumIndex struct {\n\tn      int\n\trq     int\n\twq     int\n\tweight []int\n\t// bestW[X] is a write quorum contained in X with the smallest key\n\t// (fewest nodes, then least weight, then smallest mask). 0 means no\n\t// write quorum is contained in X.\n\tbestW []uint32\n}\n\nfunc buildIndex(weights []int, rq, wq int) *quorumIndex {\n\tn := len(weights)\n\tsize := 1 << n\n\tw := make([]int, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tbit := m & -m\n\t\tw[m] = w[m^bit] + weights[bits.TrailingZeros(uint(bit))]\n\t}\n\n\tbest := make([]uint32, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tif w[m] >= wq {\n\t\t\tbest[m] = uint32(m)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Subset-lattice propagation: after processing bit i, best[X] holds the\n\t// minimum-key qualifying submask reachable by clearing any subset of the\n\t// first i bits. O(n * 2^n).\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tbit := 1 << i\n\t\tfor m := 0; m < size; m++ {\n\t\t\tif m&bit != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tif c := best[m^bit]; c != 0 && (best[m] == 0 || quorumLess(c, best[m], w)) {\n\t\t\t\t\tbest[m] = c\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn &quorumIndex{n: n, rq: rq, wq: wq, weight: w, bestW: best}\n}\n\n// quorumLess compares single-quorum masks by (node count, weight, mask).\nfunc quorumLess(a, b uint32, w []int) bool {\n\tca, cb := bits.OnesCount32(a), bits.OnesCount32(b)\n\tif ca != cb {\n\t\treturn ca < cb\n\t}\n\tif w[a] != w[b] {\n\t\treturn w[a] < w[b]\n\t}\n\treturn a < b\n}\n\ntype pair struct {\n\ta, b uint32\n}\n\n// pairKey orders counterexamples: fewest participating nodes first, then\n// least total weight, then deterministic mask tie-breaks.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) pairLess(p, q pair) bool {\n\tsa := bits.OnesCount32(p.a) + bits.OnesCount32(p.b)\n\tsb := bits.OnesCount32(q.a) + bits.OnesCount32(q.b)\n\tif sa != sb {\n\t\treturn sa < sb\n\t}\n\twa := idx.weight[p.a] + idx.weight[p.b]\n\twb := idx.weight[q.a] + idx.weight[q.b]\n\tif wa != wb {\n\t\treturn wa < wb\n\t}\n\tif p.a != q.a {\n\t\treturn p.a < q.a\n\t}\n\treturn p.b < q.b\n}\n\n// minDisjointPair returns the minimum-key disjoint quorum pair of the two\n// threshold families (rqFamily for side A, write family for side B), or\n// false if no disjoint pair exists.\n//\n// Enumerating every A is O(2^n); B is looked up in O(1) via bestW over the\n// complement of A, so the search over all pairs is exact without an O(4^n)\n// pairwise comparison.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) minDisjointPair(aThreshold int) (pair, bool) {\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tuni := uint32(1<<idx.n - 1)\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] < aThreshold {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ta := uint32(m)\n\t\tb := idx.bestW[uni^a]\n\t\tif b == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcand := pair{a, b}\n\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\n// minDisjointIn is minDisjointPair restricted to a survivor set: both quorums\n// must use surviving nodes. bestW over the full lattice is reused, queried on\n// survivors\\A so the returned B lies inside the survivor set.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) minDisjointIn(survivors uint32, aThreshold int) (pair, bool) {\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tfor a := survivors; a != 0; a = (a - 1) & survivors {\n\t\tif idx.weight[a] < aThreshold {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tb := idx.bestW[survivors&^a]\n\t\tif b == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcand := pair{a, b}\n\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\n// listQuorums returns all masks reaching threshold, ordered by key, capped at\n// maxListedSets. The exact total count is returned alongside.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) listQuorums(threshold int) (masks []uint32, total int) {\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] >= threshold {\n\t\t\ttotal++\n\t\t\tif len(masks) < maxListedSets {\n\t\t\t\tmasks = append(masks, uint32(m))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(masks, func(i, j int) bool { return quorumLess(masks[i], masks[j], idx.weight) })\n\tif total > maxListedSets {\n\t\tmasks = masks[:maxListedSets]\n\t}\n\treturn masks, total\n}\n\n// scenarioQuorums enumerates quorums restricted to a survivor mask. A single\n// submask pass counts read and write quorums and keeps the smallest listings.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) scenarioQuorums(survivors uint32) (readMasks, writeMasks []uint32, numR, numW int) {\n\tfor sub := survivors; sub != 0; sub = (sub - 1) & survivors {\n\t\twt := idx.weight[sub]\n\t\tif wt >= idx.rq {\n\t\t\tnumR++\n\t\t\tif len(readMasks) < maxListedSets {\n\t\t\t\treadMasks = append(readMasks, sub)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif wt >= idx.wq {\n\t\t\tnumW++\n\t\t\tif len(writeMasks) < maxListedSets {\n\t\t\t\twriteMasks = append(writeMasks, sub)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(readMasks, func(i, j int) bool { return quorumLess(readMasks[i], readMasks[j], idx.weight) })\n\tsort.Slice(writeMasks, func(i, j int) bool { return quorumLess(writeMasks[i], writeMasks[j], idx.weight) })\n\treturn\n}\n\nfunc maskNames(mask uint32, names []string) []string {\n\tout := []string{}\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(names); i++ {\n\t\tif mask&(1<<uint(i)) != 0 {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, names[i])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":138,"oldLines":16,"newStart":138,"newLines":20,"lines":["   return best, found"," }"," ","-// listQuorums returns all masks reaching threshold, ordered by key, capped at","-// maxListedSets. A single\n// submask pass counts read and write quorums and keeps the smallest listings.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) scenarioQuorums(survivors uint32) (readMasks, writeMasks []uint32, numR, numW int) {\n\tfor sub := survivors; sub != 0; sub = (sub - 1) & survivors {\n\t\twt := idx.weight[sub]","newString":"// scenarioQuorums enumerates canonical quorums restricted to a survivor mask\n// (zero-weight members excluded). A single submask pass counts read and write\n// quorums and keeps the smallest listings.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) scenarioQuorums(survivors uint32) (readMasks, writeMasks []uint32, numR, numW int) {\n\tfor sub := survivors; sub != 0; sub = (sub - 1) & survivors {\n\t\tif sub&idx.zeroMask != 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\twt := idx.weight[sub]","originalFile":"package quorum\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/bits\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// quorumIndex holds precomputed subset tables over the full node universe.\n//\n// Because all weights are non-negative (enforced by Validate), \"subset X\n// contains a quorum of threshold T\" is simply weight[X] >= T: if any subset\n// of X reaches T then X does too. The interesting question is whether two\n// *disjoint* quorums exist, which is answered with a subset-minimum DP.\ntype quorumIndex struct {\n\tn        int\n\trq       int\n\twq       int\n\tweight   []int\n\tzeroMask uint32\n\t// bestW[X] is a write quorum contained in X with the smallest key\n\t// (fewest nodes, then least weight, then smallest mask). 0 means no\n\t// write quorum is contained in X.\n\tbestW []uint32\n}\n\nfunc buildIndex(weights []int, rq, wq int) *quorumIndex {\n\tn := len(weights)\n\tsize := 1 << n\n\tw := make([]int, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tbit := m & -m\n\t\tw[m] = w[m^bit] + weights[bits.TrailingZeros(uint(bit))]\n\t}\n\n\tbest := make([]uint32, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tif w[m] >= wq {\n\t\t\tbest[m] = uint32(m)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Subset-lattice propagation: after processing bit i, best[X] holds the\n\t// minimum-key qualifying submask reachable by clearing any subset of the\n\t// first i bits. O(n * 2^n).\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tbit := 1 << i\n\t\tfor m := 0; m < size; m++ {\n\t\t\tif m&bit != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tif c := best[m^bit]; c != 0 && (best[m] == 0 || quorumLess(c, best[m], w)) {\n\t\t\t\t\tbest[m] = c\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn &quorumIndex{n: n, rq: rq, wq: wq, weight: w, bestW: best}\n}\n\n// quorumLess compares single-quorum masks by (node count, weight, mask).\nfunc quorumLess(a, b uint32, w []int) bool {\n\tca, cb := bits.OnesCount32(a), bits.OnesCount32(b)\n\tif ca != cb {\n\t\treturn ca < cb\n\t}\n\tif w[a] != w[b] {\n\t\treturn w[a] < w[b]\n\t}\n\treturn a < b\n}\n\ntype pair struct {\n\ta, b uint32\n}\n\n// pairKey orders counterexamples: fewest participating nodes first, then\n// least total weight, then deterministic mask tie-breaks.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) pairLess(p, q pair) bool {\n\tsa := bits.OnesCount32(p.a) + bits.OnesCount32(p.b)\n\tsb := bits.OnesCount32(q.a) + bits.OnesCount32(q.b)\n\tif sa != sb {\n\t\treturn sa < sb\n\t}\n\twa := idx.weight[p.a] + idx.weight[p.b]\n\twb := idx.weight[q.a] + idx.weight[q.b]\n\tif wa != wb {\n\t\treturn wa < wb\n\t}\n\tif p.a != q.a {\n\t\treturn p.a < q.a\n\t}\n\treturn p.b < q.b\n}\n\n// minDisjointPair returns the minimum-key disjoint quorum pair of the two\n// threshold families (rqFamily for side A, write family for side B), or\n// false if no disjoint pair exists.\n//\n// Enumerating every A is O(2^n); B is looked up in O(1) via bestW over the\n// complement of A, so the search over all pairs is exact without an O(4^n)\n// pairwise comparison.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) minDisjointPair(aThreshold int) (pair, bool) {\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tuni := uint32(1<<idx.n - 1)\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] < aThreshold {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ta := uint32(m)\n\t\tb := idx.bestW[uni^a]\n\t\tif b == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcand := pair{a, b}\n\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\n// minDisjointIn is minDisjointPair restricted to a survivor set: both quorums\n// must use surviving nodes. bestW over the full lattice is reused, queried on\n// survivors\\A so the returned B lies inside the survivor set.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) minDisjointIn(survivors uint32, aThreshold int) (pair, bool) {\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tfor a := survivors; a != 0; a = (a - 1) & survivors {\n\t\tif idx.weight[a] < aThreshold {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tb := idx.bestW[survivors&^a]\n\t\tif b == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcand := pair{a, b}\n\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\n// listQuorums returns canonical quorum masks reaching threshold, ordered by\n// key, capped at maxListedSets. A zero-weight node is never part of a\n// canonical quorum: it contributes nothing and would only create duplicate\n// representations of the same reaching set. The interesting question is whether two\n// *disjoint* quorums exist, which is answered with a subset-minimum DP.\ntype quorumIndex struct {\n\tn        int\n\trq       int\n\twq       int\n\tweight   []int\n\tzeroMask uint32\n\t// bestW[X] is a write quorum contained in X with the smallest key\n\t// (fewest nodes, then least weight, then smallest mask). 0 means no\n\t// write quorum is contained in X.\n\tbestW []uint32\n}\n\nfunc buildIndex(weights []int, rq, wq int) *quorumIndex {\n\tn := len(weights)\n\tsize := 1 << n\n\tidx := &quorumIndex{n: n, rq: rq, wq: wq, weight: make([]int, size)}\n\tfor i, w := range weights {\n\t\tif w == 0 {\n\t\t\tidx.zeroMask |= 1 << uint(i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tw := idx.weight\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tbit := m & -m\n\t\tw[m] = w[m^bit] + weights[bits.TrailingZeros(uint(bit))]\n\t}\n\n\tbest := make([]uint32, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tif w[m] >= wq {\n\t\t\tbest[m] = uint32(m)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Subset-lattice propagation: after processing bit i, best[X] holds the\n\t// minimum-key qualifying submask reachable by clearing any subset of the\n\t// first i bits. O(n * 2^n).\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tbit := 1 << i\n\t\tfor m := 0; m < size; m++ {\n\t\t\tif m&bit != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tif c := best[m^bit]; c != 0 && (best[m] == 0 || quorumLess(c, best[m], w)) {\n\t\t\t\t\tbest[m] = c\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn &quorumIndex{n: n, rq: rq, wq: wq, weight: w, bestW: best}\n}\n\n// quorumLess compares single-quorum masks by (node count, weight, mask).\nfunc quorumLess(a, b uint32, w []int) bool {\n\tca, cb := bits.OnesCount32(a), bits.OnesCount32(b)\n\tif ca != cb {\n\t\treturn ca < cb\n\t}\n\tif w[a] != w[b] {\n\t\treturn w[a] < w[b]\n\t}\n\treturn a < b\n}\n\ntype pair struct {\n\ta, b uint32\n}\n\n// pairKey orders counterexamples: fewest participating nodes first, then\n// least total weight, then deterministic mask tie-breaks.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) pairLess(p, q pair) bool {\n\tsa := bits.OnesCount32(p.a) + bits.OnesCount32(p.b)\n\tsb := bits.OnesCount32(q.a) + bits.OnesCount32(q.b)\n\tif sa != sb {\n\t\treturn sa < sb\n\t}\n\twa := idx.weight[p.a] + idx.weight[p.b]\n\twb := idx.weight[q.a] + idx.weight[q.b]\n\tif wa != wb {\n\t\treturn wa < wb\n\t}\n\tif p.a != q.a {\n\t\treturn p.a < q.a\n\t}\n\treturn p.b < q.b\n}\n\n// minDisjointPair returns the minimum-key disjoint quorum pair of the two\n// threshold families (rqFamily for side A, write family for side B), or\n// false if no disjoint pair exists.\n//\n// Enumerating every A is O(2^n); B is looked up in O(1) via bestW over the\n// complement of A, so the search over all pairs is exact without an O(4^n)\n// pairwise comparison.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) minDisjointPair(aThreshold int) (pair, bool) {\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tuni := uint32(1<<idx.n - 1)\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] < aThreshold {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ta := uint32(m)\n\t\tb := idx.bestW[uni^a]\n\t\tif b == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcand := pair{a, b}\n\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\n// minDisjointIn is minDisjointPair restricted to a survivor set: both quorums\n// must use surviving nodes. bestW over the full lattice is reused, queried on\n// survivors\\A so the returned B lies inside the survivor set.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) minDisjointIn(survivors uint32, aThreshold int) (pair, bool) {\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tfor a := survivors; a != 0; a = (a - 1) & survivors {\n\t\tif idx.weight[a] < aThreshold {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tb := idx.bestW[survivors&^a]\n\t\tif b == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcand := pair{a, b}\n\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\n// listQuorums returns canonical quorum masks reaching threshold, ordered by\n// key, capped at maxListedSets. The interesting question is whether two\n// *disjoint* quorums exist, which is answered with a subset-minimum DP.\ntype quorumIndex struct {\n\tn        int\n\trq       int\n\twq       int\n\tweight   []int\n\tzeroMask uint32\n\t// bestW[X] is a write quorum contained in X with the smallest key\n\t// (fewest nodes, then least weight, then smallest mask). 0 means no\n\t// write quorum is contained in X.\n\tbestW []uint32\n}\n\nfunc buildIndex(weights []int, rq, wq int) *quorumIndex {\n\tn := len(weights)\n\tsize := 1 << n\n\tidx := &quorumIndex{n: n, rq: rq, wq: wq, weight: make([]int, size)}\n\tfor i, w := range weights {\n\t\tif w == 0 {\n\t\t\tidx.zeroMask |= 1 << uint(i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tw := idx.weight\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tbit := m & -m\n\t\tw[m] = w[m^bit] + weights[bits.TrailingZeros(uint(bit))]\n\t}\n\n\tbest := make([]uint32, size)\n\tfor m := 1; m < size; m++ {\n\t\tif w[m] >= wq {\n\t\t\tbest[m] = uint32(m)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Subset-lattice propagation: after processing bit i, best[X] holds the\n\t// minimum-key qualifying submask reachable by clearing any subset of the\n\t// first i bits. O(n * 2^n).\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tbit := 1 << i\n\t\tfor m := 0; m < size; m++ {\n\t\t\tif m&bit != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tif c := best[m^bit]; c != 0 && (best[m] == 0 || quorumLess(c, best[m], w)) {\n\t\t\t\t\tbest[m] = c\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tidx.bestW = best\n\treturn idx\n}\n\n// quorumLess compares single-quorum masks by (node count, weight, mask).\nfunc quorumLess(a, b uint32, w []int) bool {\n\tca, cb := bits.OnesCount32(a), bits.OnesCount32(b)\n\tif ca != cb {\n\t\treturn ca < cb\n\t}\n\tif w[a] != w[b] {\n\t\treturn w[a] < w[b]\n\t}\n\treturn a < b\n}\n\ntype pair struct {\n\ta, b uint32\n}\n\n// pairKey orders counterexamples: fewest participating nodes first, then\n// least total weight, then deterministic mask tie-breaks.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) pairLess(p, q pair) bool {\n\tsa := bits.OnesCount32(p.a) + bits.OnesCount32(p.b)\n\tsb := bits.OnesCount32(q.a) + bits.OnesCount32(q.b)\n\tif sa != sb {\n\t\treturn sa < sb\n\t}\n\twa := idx.weight[p.a] + idx.weight[p.b]\n\twb := idx.weight[q.a] + idx.weight[q.b]\n\tif wa != wb {\n\t\treturn wa < wb\n\t}\n\tif p.a != q.a {\n\t\treturn p.a < q.a\n\t}\n\treturn p.b < q.b\n}\n\n// minDisjointPair returns the minimum-key disjoint quorum pair of the two\n// threshold families (rqFamily for side A, write family for side B), or\n// false if no disjoint pair exists.\n//\n// Enumerating every A is O(2^n); B is looked up in O(1) via bestW over the\n// complement of A, so the search over all pairs is exact without an O(4^n)\n// pairwise comparison.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) minDisjointPair(aThreshold int) (pair, bool) {\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tuni := uint32(1<<idx.n - 1)\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] < aThreshold {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ta := uint32(m)\n\t\tb := idx.bestW[uni^a]\n\t\tif b == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcand := pair{a, b}\n\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\n// minDisjointIn is minDisjointPair restricted to a survivor set: both quorums\n// must use surviving nodes. bestW over the full lattice is reused, queried on\n// survivors\\A so the returned B lies inside the survivor set.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) minDisjointIn(survivors uint32, aThreshold int) (pair, bool) {\n\tvar best pair\n\tfound := false\n\tfor a := survivors; a != 0; a = (a - 1) & survivors {\n\t\tif idx.weight[a] < aThreshold {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tb := idx.bestW[survivors&^a]\n\t\tif b == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcand := pair{a, b}\n\t\tif !found || idx.pairLess(cand, best) {\n\t\t\tbest, found = cand, true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best, found\n}\n\n// listQuorums returns canonical quorum masks reaching threshold, ordered by\n// key, capped at maxListedSets. A zero-weight node is never part of a\n// canonical quorum: it contributes nothing and would only create duplicate\n// representations of the same reaching set. The exact total count of\n// canonical quorums is returned alongside.\nfunc (idx *quorumIndex) listQuorums(threshold int) (masks []uint32, total int) {\n\tfor m := 1; m < len(idx.weight); m++ {\n\t\tif idx.weight[m] < threshold || m&idx.zeroMask != 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ttotal++\n\t\tif len(masks) < maxListedSets {\n\t\t\tmasks = append(masks, uint32(m))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(masks, func(i, j int) bool { return quorumLess(masks[i], masks[j], idx.weight) })\n\tif total > maxListedSets {\n\t\tmasks = masks[:maxListedSets]\n\t}\n\treturn masks, total\n}\n\n\n// scenarioQuorums enumerates canonical quorums restricted to a survivor mask\n// (zero-weight members excluded). {"parentUuid":"00945ef4-586a-4690-8154-effbaaed91c3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_rdsz91ecx1fq9glpp40wdhbg","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp29/b/README.md","content":"# quorumcheck — 加权法定人数检查器\n\n纯后端工具：验证带整数权重的读/写法定人数配置，**精确穷举**所有法定人数集合，\n检测读–写与写–写相交性，枚举故障域（机架、可用区等）整体失效后的可用集合，\n并通过一个**确定性离散事件模拟器**在单进程内复现网络丢包、重复、乱序下的\n行为。不依赖任何真实集群、网络或 goroutine（模拟完全由事件堆驱动）。\n\n## 它解决什么问题\n\n一个复制系统把读法定人数阈值记为 `R`、写法定人数阈值记为 `W`，节点带整数\n权重，节点按故障域分组。要安全，必须满足：\n\n- **写–写相交**：任意两个可能同时成功的写法定人数至少共享一个节点\n  （否则两个写可以无共同见证者地同时提交，先后顺序不可判定）；\n- **读–写相交**：任意读法定人数与任意写法定人数至少共享一个节点\n  （否则读可能完全错过一次已提交的写，返回旧值）；\n- **故障域可用性**：在配置允许的任意 `k` 个整域失效后，剩余权重仍能组成\n  读、写法定人数。\n\n经典充分条件是 `R + W > totalWeight` 与 `2W > totalWeight`；但权重与故障域\n不均匀时，条件本身需要逐集合检验。本工具直接枚举集合给出确定答案，并在不安全\n时输出**最小反例**（参与节点最少、总权重最小、字典序兜底）。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\ncmd/quorumcheck/      CLI：stdin 读 JSON、stdout 写 JSON\ninternal/quorum/      配置验证 + 掩码穷举分析器（O(n·2^n) 格 DP）\ninternal/sim/         确定性离散事件模拟器 + 网络策略 + 反例见证构造\nexamples/             请求样例与实际运行输出（examples/output/）\n```\n\n## 构建与测试\n\n需要 Go 1.22+，无第三方依赖。\n\n```bash\ngo build ./...\ngo test ./...          # 全部自动化测试\ngo test -race ./...    # 竞态检测\n```\n\n## 使用\n\n```bash\ngo run ./cmd/quorumcheck [analyze|simulate|all] < request.json\n# 或先构建：\ngo build -o quorumcheck ./cmd/quorumcheck\n./quorumcheck analyze < examples/01-safe-majority.json\n```\n\n- `analyze`：只做配置验证与穷举分析；\n- `simulate`：必须带 `sim` 段，跑离散事件模拟；\n- `all`（默认）：分析 + 对每个最小反例自动生成**模拟器见证**（脚本化网络把\n  反例一对法定人数真实跑出来），并在给出 `sim` 段时一并模拟。\n\n退出码：`0` 正常（**不安全配置也算正常运行**，结果在 JSON 中）；\n`2` 请求非法（配置错误或 JSON 错误，错误在 stdout 的 `errors` 字段）；\n`1` 用法或 IO 错误。\n\n## 请求格式\n\n```jsonc\n{\n  \"action\": \"all\",                 // 可省略，也可用命令行参数覆盖\n  \"config\": {\n    \"nodes\": [\n      {\"id\": \"n1\", \"weight\": 3, \"domain\": \"az-1\"},  // 权重必须是非负整数\n      {\"id\": \"n2\", \"weight\": 2, \"domain\": \"az-2\"},\n      {\"id\": \"observer\", \"weight\": 0, \"domain\": \"az-1\"} // 零权重：警告，永不计入\n    ],\n    \"read_quorum\": 2,              // 正整数权重阈值\n    \"write_quorum\": 4,\n    \"tolerate_domains\": 1          // 要容忍多少个整域同时失效\n  },\n  \"sim\": {                         // 仅 simulate / all 需要\n    \"seed\": 42,                    // 固定种子；同种子逐位可复现\n    \"runs\": 10,                    // 随机模式运行次数（脚本规则强制 1 次）\n    \"operations\": 4,               // 每次运行并发发起的操作数\n    \"kind\": \"mixed\",               // ww | rw | mixed\n    \"horizon\": 120,                // 虚拟时间上限\n    \"client_timeout\": 10,          // 未凑齐则重发的时间\n    \"max_attempts\": 6,\n    \"failed_domains\": [\"az-1\"],    // 整域故障：发往这些节点的报文直接消失\n    \"network\": {                   // 随机网络策略\n      \"loss_rate\": 0.2,            // 每条报文独立丢弃概率\n      \"duplicate_rate\": 0.25,      // 复制为两份的概率（客户端按节点去重）\n      \"min_delay\": 1,\n      \"max_delay\": 4,\n      \"reorder_window\": 2          // >0 时部分报文在窗口内提前/推后造成乱序\n    },\n    \"rules\": [ /* 或提供规则做确定性脚本化网络，见 examples/05 */ ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n`rules` 按顺序匹配，第一条命中决定报文命运；字段（`from/to/role/msg_type/op/\nmin_attempt`）均可省略表示通配。`action` 为 `deliver`（含 `delay`）、\n`drop`、`duplicate`（含 `duplicates` 额外副本数）。`role` 为操作在并发对中\n的角色 `A`/`B`，整域故障节点的请求带角色 `dead`。\n\n## 输出要点（`report`）\n\n- `valid` / `errors`：配置是否合法（重复节点 id、负权重、阈值超过总权重、\n  节点数超过穷举上限 20 等）；\n- `warnings`：零权重节点、缺失故障域等非致命问题；\n- `num_read_quorums` / `num_write_quorums`：法定人数集合**精确数量**，\n  `read_quorums` / `write_quorums` 为按（节点数、权重、掩码）排序的前若干个；\n- `ww_safe` / `rw_safe`：相交性结论；不安全时有\n  `minimal_ww_counterexample` / `minimal_rw_counterexample`，给出两个不相交\n  集合、各自权重与文字解释，`all` 动作还在 `witness` 里附上能在模拟器中复现\n  违例的脚本化输入与运行结果；\n- `available` / `minimal_availability_failure`：允许的整域故障下是否始终\n  可用，以及最小的不可用故障组合；`availability_witness` 用“完美网络 +\n  这些域宕机”的脚本运行证明不可用来自故障而非丢包；\n- `scenarios`：无故障场景、不可用场景（优先）、部分健康场景，外加一个\n  `beyond_tolerance: true` 的“全域宕机”参考场景。\n\n## 算法说明\n\n- 节点子集编码为位掩码（最多 20 个节点，2^20 个集合），一次递推求出每个\n  子集的总权重；\n- “两个不相交法定人数是否存在”用子集格上的最小传播 DP（SOS DP 风格）在\n  O(n·2^n) 内精确求解，避免 O(4^n) 两两比较；\n- 对每个掩码 A，在其补集的 `bestW` 表中 O(1) 取出最小的法定人数 B，遍历\n  全体 A 即得全局最小不相交对；\n- 故障域组合只在权重和层面做可用性判定（O(k)），指数级的集合枚举只对进入\n  报告的有限场景运行；\n- 模拟器是整数虚拟时钟 + 最小堆事件循环；随机源为内置 splitmix64，\n  无系统熵，同种子同输入逐位复现；\n- 测试包内另含一个朴素 O(4^n) 暴力参考实现，对结构化用例与数千个随机\n  权重/阈值组合做交叉校验（见 `internal/quorum/masks_test.go`）。\n\n## 边界与限制\n\n- 穷举上限 20 个节点（内存约每表 4 MiB）；域故障组合数有上限（200000），\n  超出会产生 `scenario_enumeration_truncated` 警告且可用性结论保守；\n- 模拟器验证的是“协议可到达的交错”，随机性只抽样不覆盖全部调度；安全性的\n  权威结论来自穷举分析器，模拟器用于解释与见证；\n- 节点是无状态应答者：模拟的是法定人数交集本身，不包含版本向量/MVCC 等\n  上层机制。\n\n## 请求样例\n\n| 文件 | 场景 |\n|---|---|\n| `examples/01-safe-majority.json` | 3 节点多数派 + 一个零权重观察者（警告） |\n| `examples/02-rw-unsafe.json` | 权重 3/2/1，R=2 W=4：读写不相交，且丢失 az-1 后不可用 |\n| `examples/03-domain-outage.json` | 5 节点 3 域，权重倾斜下的整域失效枚举 |\n| `examples/04-lossy-network.json` | 20% 丢包 + 25% 重复 + 乱序的 10 次随机运行 |\n| `examples/05-scripted-split.json` | 脚本化“脑裂”：两个写分别只听到不同单节点 |\n\n`examples/output/` 保存了这些请求在本机的实际 JSON 输出。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_22a35bc068c768c7dc4a8b47","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1343,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":87864,"output_tokens":2501,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_rdsz91ecx1fq9glpp40wdhbg":{"content":"# 故障域组合只在权重和层面做可用性判定（O(k)），指数级的集合枚举只对进入\n  报告的有限场景运行；\n- 模拟器是整数虚拟时钟 + 最小堆事件循环；随机源为内置 splitmix64，\n  无系统熵，同种子同输入逐位复现；\n- 测试包内另含一个朴素 O(4^n) 暴力参考实现，对结构化用例与数千个随机\n  权重/阈值组合做交叉校验（见 quorumcheck — 加权法定人数检查器\n\n纯后端工具：验证带整数权重的读/写法定人数配置，**精确穷举**所有法定人数集合，\n检测读–写与写–写相交性，枚举故障域（机架、可用区等）整体失效后的可用集合，\n并通过一个**确定性离散事件模拟器**在单进程内复现网络丢包、重复、乱序下的\n行为。不依赖任何真实集群、网络或 goroutine（模拟完全由事件堆驱动）。\n\n## 它解决什么问题\n\n一个复制系统把读法定人数阈值记为 `R`、写法定人数阈值记为 `W`，节点带整数\n权重，节点按故障域分组。要安全，必须满足：\n\n- **写–写相交**：任意两个可能同时成功的写法定人数至少共享一个节点\n  （否则两个写可以无共同见证者地同时提交，先后顺序不可判定）；\n- **读–写相交**：任意读法定人数与任意写法定人数至少共享一个节点\n  （否则读可能完全错过一次已提交的写，返回旧值）；\n- **故障域可用性**：在配置允许的任意 `k` 个整域失效后，剩余权重仍能组成\n  读、写法定人数。\n\n经典充分条件是 `R + W > totalWeight` 与 `2W > totalWeight`；但权重与故障域\n不均匀时，条件本身需要逐集合检验。本工具直接枚举集合给出确定答案，并在不安全\n时输出**最小反例**（参与节点最少、总权重最小、字典序兜底）。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\ncmd/quorumcheck/      CLI：stdin 读 JSON、stdout 写 JSON\ninternal/quorum/      配置验证 + 掩码穷举分析器（O(n·2^n) 格 DP）\ninternal/sim/         确定性离散事件模拟器 + 网络策略 + 反例见证构造\nexamples/             请求样例与实际运行输出（examples/output/）\n```\n\n## 构建与测试\n\n需要 Go 1.22+，无第三方依赖。\n\n```bash\ngo build ./...\ngo test ./...          # 全部自动化测试\ngo test -race ./...    # 竞态检测\n```\n\n## 使用\n\n```bash\ngo run ./cmd/quorumcheck [analyze|simulate|all] < request.json\n# 或先构建：\ngo build -o quorumcheck ./cmd/quorumcheck\n./quorumcheck analyze < examples/01-safe-majority.json\n```\n\n- `analyze`：只做配置验证与穷举分析；\n- `simulate`：必须带 `sim` 段，跑离散事件模拟；\n- `all`（默认）：分析 + 对每个最小反例自动生成**模拟器见证**（脚本化网络把\n  反例一对法定人数真实跑出来），并在给出 `sim` 段时一并模拟。\n\n退出码：`0` 正常（**不安全配置也算正常运行**，结果在 JSON 中）；\n`2` 请求非法（配置错误或 JSON 错误，错误在 stdout 的 `errors` 字段）；\n`1` 用法或 IO 错误。\n\n## 请求格式\n\n```jsonc\n{\n  \"action\": \"all\",                 // 可省略，也可用命令行参数覆盖\n  \"config\": {\n    \"nodes\": [\n      {\"id\": \"n1\", \"weight\": 3, \"domain\": \"az-1\"},  // 权重必须是非负整数\n      {\"id\": \"n2\", \"weight\": 2, \"domain\": \"az-2\"},\n      {\"id\": \"observer\", \"weight\": 0, \"domain\": \"az-1\"} // 零权重：警告，永不计入\n    ],\n    \"read_quorum\": 2,              // 正整数权重阈值\n    \"write_quorum\": 4,\n    \"tolerate_domains\": 1          // 要容忍多少个整域同时失效\n  },\n  \"sim\": {                         // 仅 simulate / all 需要\n    \"seed\": 42,                    // 固定种子；同种子逐位可复现\n    \"runs\": 10,                    // 随机模式运行次数（脚本规则强制 1 次）\n    \"operations\": 4,               // 每次运行并发发起的操作数\n    \"kind\": \"mixed\",               // ww | rw | mixed\n    \"horizon\": 120,                // 虚拟时间上限\n    \"client_timeout\": 10,          // 未凑齐则重发的时间\n    \"max_attempts\": 6,\n    \"failed_domains\": [\"az-1\"],    // 整域故障：发往这些节点的报文直接消失\n    \"network\": {                   // 随机网络策略\n      \"loss_rate\": 0.2,            // 每条报文独立丢弃概率\n      \"duplicate_rate\": 0.25,      // 复制为两份的概率（客户端按节点去重）\n      \"min_delay\": 1,\n      \"max_delay\": 4,\n      \"reorder_window\": 2          // >0 时部分报文在窗口内提前/推后造成乱序\n    },\n    \"rules\": [ /* 或提供规则做确定性脚本化网络，见 examples/05 */ ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n`rules` 按顺序匹配，第一条命中决定报文命运；字段（`from/to/role/msg_type/op/\nmin_attempt`）均可省略表示通配。`action` 为 `deliver`（含 `delay`）、\n`drop`、`duplicate`（含 `duplicates` 额外副本数）。`role` 为操作在并发对中\n的角色 `A`/`B`，整域故障节点的请求带角色 `dead`。\n\n## 输出要点（`report`）\n\n- `valid` / `errors`：配置是否合法（重复节点 id、负权重、阈值超过总权重、\n  节点数超过穷举上限 20 等）；\n- 个节点，2^20 个集合），一次递推求出每个\n  子集的总权重；\n- “两个不相交法定人数是否存在”用子集格上的最小传播 DP（SOS DP 风格）在\n  O(n·2^n) 内精确求解，避免 O(4^n) 两两比较；\n- 对每个掩码 A，在其补集的 `bestW` 表中 O(1) 取出最小的法定人数 B，遍历\n  全体 A 即得全局最小不相交对；\n- `examples/03-domain-outage.json` | 5 节点 3 域，权重倾斜下的整域失效枚举 |","newString":"| `examples/03-domain-outage.json` | 5 节点 3 域：容忍单域失效的枚举与参考场景 |","originalFile":"# quorumcheck — 加权法定人数检查器\n\n纯后端工具：验证带整数权重的读/写法定人数配置，**精确穷举**所有法定人数集合，\n检测读–写与写–写相交性，枚举故障域（机架、可用区等）整体失效后的可用集合，\n并通过一个**确定性离散事件模拟器**在单进程内复现网络丢包、重复、乱序下的\n行为。不依赖任何真实集群、网络或 goroutine（模拟完全由事件堆驱动）。\n\n## 它解决什么问题\n\n一个复制系统把读法定人数阈值记为 `R`、写法定人数阈值记为 `W`，节点带整数\n权重，节点按故障域分组。要安全，必须满足：\n\n- **写–写相交**：任意两个可能同时成功的写法定人数至少共享一个节点\n  （否则两个写可以无共同见证者地同时提交，先后顺序不可判定）；\n- **读–写相交**：任意读法定人数与任意写法定人数至少共享一个节点\n  （否则读可能完全错过一次已提交的写，返回旧值）；\n- **故障域可用性**：在配置允许的任意 `k` 个整域失效后，剩余权重仍能组成\n  读、写法定人数。\n\n经典充分条件是 `R + W > totalWeight` 与 `2W > totalWeight`；但权重与故障域\n不均匀时，条件本身需要逐集合检验。本工具直接枚举集合给出确定答案，并在不安全\n时输出**最小反例**（参与节点最少、总权重最小、字典序兜底）。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\ncmd/quorumcheck/      CLI：stdin 读 JSON、stdout 写 JSON\ninternal/quorum/      配置验证 + 掩码穷举分析器（O(n·2^n) 格 DP）\ninternal/sim/         确定性离散事件模拟器 + 网络策略 + 反例见证构造\nexamples/             请求样例与实际运行输出（examples/output/）\n```\n\n## 构建与测试\n\n需要 Go 1.22+，无第三方依赖。\n\n```bash\ngo build ./...\ngo test ./...          # 全部自动化测试\ngo test -race ./...    # 竞态检测\n```\n\n## 使用\n\n```bash\ngo run ./cmd/quorumcheck [analyze|simulate|all] < request.json\n# 或先构建：\ngo build -o quorumcheck ./cmd/quorumcheck\n./quorumcheck analyze < examples/01-safe-majority.json\n```\n\n- `analyze`：只做配置验证与穷举分析；\n- `simulate`：必须带 `sim` 段，跑离散事件模拟；\n- `all`（默认）：分析 + 对每个最小反例自动生成**模拟器见证**（脚本化网络把\n  反例一对法定人数真实跑出来），并在给出 `sim` 段时一并模拟。\n\n退出码：`0` 正常（**不安全配置也算正常运行**，结果在 JSON 中）；\n`2` 请求非法（配置错误或 JSON 错误，错误在 stdout 的 `errors` 字段）；\n`1` 用法或 IO 错误。\n\n## 请求格式\n\n```jsonc\n{\n  \"action\": \"all\",                 // 可省略，也可用命令行参数覆盖\n  \"config\": {\n    \"nodes\": [\n      {\"id\": \"n1\", \"weight\": 3, \"domain\": \"az-1\"},  // 权重必须是非负整数\n      {\"id\": \"n2\", \"weight\": 2, \"domain\": \"az-2\"},\n      {\"id\": \"observer\", \"weight\": 0, \"domain\": \"az-1\"} // 零权重：警告，永不计入\n    ],\n    \"read_quorum\": 2,              // 正整数权重阈值\n    \"write_quorum\": 4,\n    \"tolerate_domains\": 1          // 要容忍多少个整域同时失效\n  },\n  \"sim\": {                         // 仅 simulate / all 需要\n    \"seed\": 42,                    // 固定种子；同种子逐位可复现\n    \"runs\": 10,                    // 随机模式运行次数（脚本规则强制 1 次）\n    \"operations\": 4,               // 每次运行并发发起的操作数\n    \"kind\": \"mixed\",               // ww | rw | mixed\n    \"horizon\": 120,                // 虚拟时间上限\n    \"client_timeout\": 10,          // 未凑齐则重发的时间\n    \"max_attempts\": 6,\n    \"failed_domains\": [\"az-1\"],    // 整域故障：发往这些节点的报文直接消失\n    \"network\": {                   // 随机网络策略\n      \"loss_rate\": 0.2,            // 每条报文独立丢弃概率\n      \"duplicate_rate\": 0.25,      // 复制为两份的概率（客户端按节点去重）\n      \"min_delay\": 1,\n      \"max_delay\": 4,\n      \"reorder_window\": 2          // >0 时部分报文在窗口内提前/推后造成乱序\n    },\n    \"rules\": [ /* 或提供规则做确定性脚本化网络，见 examples/05 */ ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n`rules` 按顺序匹配，第一条命中决定报文命运；字段（`from/to/role/msg_type/op/\nmin_attempt`）均可省略表示通配。`action` 为 `deliver`（含 `delay`）、\n`drop`、`duplicate`（含 `duplicates` 额外副本数）。`role` 为操作在并发对中\n的角色 `A`/`B`，整域故障节点的请求带角色 `dead`。\n\n## 输出要点（`report`）\n\n- `valid` / `errors`：配置是否合法（重复节点 id、负权重、阈值超过总权重、\n  节点数超过穷举上限 20 等）；\n- `warnings`：零权重节点、缺失故障域等非致命问题；\n- `num_read_quorums` / `num_write_quorums`：法定人数集合**精确数量**，\n  `read_quorums` / `write_quorums` 为按（节点数、权重、掩码）排序的前若干个；\n- `ww_safe` / `rw_safe`：相交性结论；不安全时有\n  `minimal_ww_counterexample` / `minimal_rw_counterexample`，给出两个不相交\n  集合、各自权重与文字解释，`all` 动作还在 `witness` 里附上能在模拟器中复现\n  违例的脚本化输入与运行结果；\n- `available` / `minimal_availability_failure`：允许的整域故障下是否始终\n  可用，以及最小的不可用故障组合；`availability_witness` 用“完美网络 +\n  这些域宕机”的脚本运行证明不可用来自故障而非丢包；\n- `scenarios`：无故障场景、不可用场景（优先）、部分健康场景，外加一个\n  `beyond_tolerance: true` 的“全域宕机”参考场景。\n\n## 算法说明\n\n- 节点子集编码为位掩码（最多 20 个节点，2^20 个集合），一次递推求出每个\n  子集的总权重；\n- “两个不相交法定人数是否存在”用子集格上的最小传播 DP（SOS DP 风格）在\n  O(n·2^n) 内精确求解，避免 O(4^n) 两两比较；\n- 对每个掩码 A，在其补集的 `bestW` 表中 O(1) 取出最小的法定人数 B，遍历\n  全体 A 即得全局最小不相交对；\n- 故障域组合只在权重和层面做可用性判定（O(k)），指数级的集合枚举只对进入\n  报告的有限场景运行；\n- 模拟器是整数虚拟时钟 + 最小堆事件循环；随机源为内置 splitmix64，\n  无系统熵，同种子同输入逐位复现；\n- 测试包内另含一个朴素 O(4^n) 暴力参考实现，对结构化用例与数千个随机\n  权重/阈值组合做交叉校验（见 `internal/quorum/masks_test.go`）。\n\n## 边界与限制\n\n- 穷举上限 20 个节点（内存约每表 4 MiB）；域故障组合数有上限（200000），\n  超出会产生 `scenario_enumeration_truncated` 警告且可用性结论保守；\n- 模拟器验证的是“协议可到达的交错”，随机性只抽样不覆盖全部调度；安全性的\n  权威结论来自穷举分析器，模拟器用于解释与见证；\n- 节点是无状态应答者：模拟的是法定人数交集本身，不包含版本向量/MVCC 等\n  上层机制。\n\n## 请求样例\n\n| 文件 | 场景 |\n|---|---|\n| `examples/01-safe-majority.json` | 3 节点多数派 + 一个零权重观察者（警告） |\n| `examples/02-rw-unsafe.json` | 权重 3/2/1，R=2 W=4：读写不相交，且丢失 az-1 后不可用 |\n| `examples/03-domain-outage.json` | 5 节点 3 域，权重倾斜下的整域失效枚举 |\n| `examples/04-lossy-network.json` | 20% 丢包 + 25% 重复 + 乱序的 10 次随机运行 |\n| `examples/05-scripted-split.json` | 脚本化“脑裂”：两个写分别只听到不同单节点 |\n\n`examples/output/` 保存了这些请求在本机的实际 JSON 输出。\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":146,"oldLines":7,"newStart":146,"newLines":7,"lines":[" {"parentUuid":"ba23718a-6b35-4d55-a9f8-fca3b8b31589","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"signature":"","thinking":"Found a real bug!\n\nThe bug occurs during violations report operations: a write can complete even when the node weight (1) is below the write quorum threshold (2). {"parentUuid":"b328e52b-08cb-45b2-9fb7-588b8febf078","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_u8if9cx3wuo2l6ww3m98rk5k","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp29/b/internal/sim/engine_test.go","old_string":"func TestPerfectNetworkCompletes(t *testing.T) {","new_string":"func TestMajorityNeverViolatesUnderLoss(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Regression: a retransmission used to clear the responder set but not\n\t// the accumulated weight, so one node answering on two attempts counted\n\t// twice and an op \"completed\" at weight 1 of threshold 2. With correct\n\t// cross-attempt node dedup, every completed op on a 3-node 2/3 system\n\t// touches >=2 nodes; any two such sets intersect (pigeonhole), so a safe\n\t// configuration must produce ZERO violations over many lossy runs.\n\tin := RunInput{\n\t\tNodes: nodes3(), ReadQuorum: 2, WriteQuorum: 2,\n\t\tSim: Sim{\n\t\t\tSeed: 20260923, Runs: 60, Operations: 4, Kind: \"mixed\",\n\t\t\tHorizon: 120, ClientTimeout: 6, MaxAttempts: 8,\n\t\t\tNetwork: &Network{LossRate: 0.45, DuplicateRate: 0.4, MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 3, ReorderWindow: 1},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n\tr := Run(in)\n\tif len(r.Errors) > 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(r.Errors)\n\t}\n\tif r.CompletedTotal == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected some operations to complete despite losses\")\n\t}\n\tif r.ViolationRuns != 0 || len(r.Violations) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"safe majority violated: %+v\", r.Violations)\n\t}\n\t// Every completed op must genuinely reach its threshold from distinct\n\t// nodes.\n\tfor _, rr := range r.RunResults {\n\t\tfor _, op := range rr.CompletedOps {\n\t\t\tif len(op.Responders) != op.Weight {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s: weight %d != %d distinct responders %v\", op.Op, op.Weight, len(op.Responders), op.Responders)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tthreshold := 2\n\t\t\tif op.Weight < threshold {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s completed below threshold: %v\", op.Op, op)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestCrossAttemptNodeDedup(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Direct probe: only n1 ever answers (its requests delivered), n2/n3\n\t// requests are dropped on the first attempt but delivered on later\n\t// attempts. 运行记录（实测）\n\n环境：Linux x86_64，Go 1.22.2，无第三方依赖。\n\n```\n$ go vet ./...                      # 通过\n$ go test -race -count=1 ./...      # 三个包全部 ok\nok  \tquorumcheck/cmd/quorumcheck\nok  \tquorumcheck/internal/quorum\nok  \tquorumcheck/internal/sim\n$ go test -cover ./...              # 覆盖率 75% / 92.3% / 93.0%\n```\n\n- 20 节点（2^20 集合、10 个故障域）完整穷举：约 0.09 s，法定人数集合\n  精确计数 214957（列表截断为前 64 个，计数不截断）。\n- 确定性：同一带损网络请求连续运行两次，输出 JSON 逐字节相同（splitmix64\n  固定种子）。\n- 交叉校验：DP 结论与朴素 O(4^n) 暴力实现，在结构化用例与 4000 组随机\n  权重/阈值上完全一致；并验证 `R+W>W_total`、`2W>W_total` 经典定理及其\n  等号可分性。\n\n**开发中发现并修复的一个缺陷（如实记录）**：初版模拟器在重传时清空了\n“已响应节点集合”却没有同时清空累计权重，导致同一节点在两次尝试中各应答\n一次时权重被重复累计——单个权重 1 的节点可能把阈值 2 的操作“凑满”。\n交叉测试中表现为：安全的 2/3 多数派配置在有损网络下被报告了不可能存在的\n违例（任意两个 ≥2/3 集合必相交）。修复为客户端跨尝试按节点全局去重、权重\n即该去重集合之和，并新增回归测试 `TestMajorityNeverViolatesUnderLoss`（60\n次高丢包运行零违例）与 `TestCrossAttemptNodeDedup`（单节点多次应答永不\n凑齐法定人数）。修复后示例 04 为 40/40 完成、0 违例。\n","originalFile":"# quorumcheck — 加权法定人数检查器\n\n纯后端工具：验证带整数权重的读/写法定人数配置，**精确穷举**所有法定人数集合，\n检测读–写与写–写相交性，枚举故障域（机架、可用区等）整体失效后的可用集合，\n并通过一个**确定性离散事件模拟器**在单进程内复现网络丢包、重复、乱序下的\n行为。不依赖任何真实集群、网络或 goroutine（模拟完全由事件堆驱动）。\n\n## 它解决什么问题\n\n一个复制系统把读法定人数阈值记为 `R`、写法定人数阈值记为 `W`，节点带整数\n权重，节点按故障域分组。要安全，必须满足：\n\n- **写–写相交**：任意两个可能同时成功的写法定人数至少共享一个节点\n  （否则两个写可以无共同见证者地同时提交，先后顺序不可判定）；\n- **读–写相交**：任意读法定人数与任意写法定人数至少共享一个节点\n  （否则读可能完全错过一次已提交的写，返回旧值）；\n- **故障域可用性**：在配置允许的任意 `k` 个整域失效后，剩余权重仍能组成\n  读、写法定人数。\n\n经典充分条件是 `R + W > totalWeight` 与 `2W > totalWeight`；但权重与故障域\n不均匀时，条件本身需要逐集合检验。本工具直接枚举集合给出确定答案，并在不安全\n时输出**最小反例**（参与节点最少、总权重最小、字典序兜底）。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\ncmd/quorumcheck/      CLI：stdin 读 JSON、stdout 写 JSON\ninternal/quorum/      配置验证 + 掩码穷举分析器（O(n·2^n) 格 DP）\ninternal/sim/         确定性离散事件模拟器 + 网络策略 + 反例见证构造\nexamples/             请求样例与实际运行输出（examples/output/）\n```\n\n## 构建与测试\n\n需要 Go 1.22+，无第三方依赖。\n\n```bash\ngo build ./...\ngo test ./...          # 全部自动化测试\ngo test -race ./...    # 竞态检测\n```\n\n## 使用\n\n```bash\ngo run ./cmd/quorumcheck [analyze|simulate|all] < request.json\n# 或先构建：\ngo build -o quorumcheck ./cmd/quorumcheck\n./quorumcheck analyze < examples/01-safe-majority.json\n```\n\n- `analyze`：只做配置验证与穷举分析；\n- `simulate`：必须带 `sim` 段，跑离散事件模拟；\n- `all`（默认）：分析 + 对每个最小反例自动生成**模拟器见证**（脚本化网络把\n  反例一对法定人数真实跑出来），并在给出 `sim` 段时一并模拟。\n\n退出码：`0` 正常（**不安全配置也算正常运行**，结果在 JSON 中）；\n`2` 请求非法（配置错误或 JSON 错误，错误在 stdout 的 `errors` 字段）；\n`1` 用法或 IO 错误。\n\n## 请求格式\n\n```jsonc\n{\n  \"action\": \"all\",                 // 可省略，也可用命令行参数覆盖\n  \"config\": {\n    \"nodes\": [\n      {\"id\": \"n1\", \"weight\": 3, \"domain\": \"az-1\"},  // 权重必须是非负整数\n      {\"id\": \"n2\", \"weight\": 2, \"domain\": \"az-2\"},\n      {\"id\": \"observer\", \"weight\": 0, \"domain\": \"az-1\"} // 零权重：警告，永不计入\n    ],\n    \"read_quorum\": 2,              // 正整数权重阈值\n    \"write_quorum\": 4,\n    \"tolerate_domains\": 1          // 要容忍多少个整域同时失效\n  },\n  \"sim\": {                         // 仅 simulate / all 需要\n    \"seed\": 42,                    // 固定种子；同种子逐位可复现\n    \"runs\": 10,                    // 随机模式运行次数（脚本规则强制 1 次）\n    \"operations\": 4,               // 每次运行并发发起的操作数\n    \"kind\": \"mixed\",               // ww | rw | mixed\n    \"horizon\": 120,                // 虚拟时间上限\n    \"client_timeout\": 10,          // 未凑齐则重发的时间\n    \"max_attempts\": 6,\n    \"failed_domains\": [\"az-1\"],    // 整域故障：发往这些节点的报文直接消失\n    \"network\": {                   // 随机网络策略\n      \"loss_rate\": 0.2,            // 每条报文独立丢弃概率\n      \"duplicate_rate\": 0.25,      // 复制为两份的概率（客户端按节点去重）\n      \"min_delay\": 1,\n      \"max_delay\": 4,\n      \"reorder_window\": 2          // >0 时部分报文在窗口内提前/推后造成乱序\n    },\n    \"rules\": [ /* 或提供规则做确定性脚本化网络，见 examples/05 */ ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n`rules` 按顺序匹配，第一条命中决定报文命运；字段（`from/to/role/msg_type/op/\nmin_attempt`）均可省略表示通配。`action` 为 `deliver`（含 `delay`）、\n`drop`、`duplicate`（含 `duplicates` 额外副本数）。`role` 为操作在并发对中\n的角色 `A`/`B`，整域故障节点的请求带角色 `dead`。\n\n## 输出要点（`report`）\n\n- `valid` / `errors`：配置是否合法（重复节点 id、负权重、阈值超过总权重、\n  节点数超过穷举上限 20 等）；\n- `warnings`：零权重节点、缺失故障域等非致命问题；\n- `num_read_quorums` / `num_write_quorums`：法定人数集合**精确数量**，\n  `read_quorums` / `write_quorums` 为按（节点数、权重、掩码）排序的前若干个；\n- `ww_safe` / `rw_safe`：相交性结论；不安全时有\n  `minimal_ww_counterexample` / `minimal_rw_counterexample`，给出两个不相交\n  集合、各自权重与文字解释，`all` 动作还在 `witness` 里附上能在模拟器中复现\n  违例的脚本化输入与运行结果；\n- `available` / `minimal_availability_failure`：允许的整域故障下是否始终\n  可用，以及最小的不可用故障组合；`availability_witness` 用“完美网络 +\n  这些域宕机”的脚本运行证明不可用来自故障而非丢包；\n- `scenarios`：无故障场景、不可用场景（优先）、部分健康场景，外加一个\n  `beyond_tolerance: true` 的“全域宕机”参考场景。\n\n## 算法说明\n\n- 节点子集编码为位掩码（最多 20 个节点，2^20 个集合），一次递推求出每个\n  子集的总权重；\n- “两个不相交法定人数是否存在”用子集格上的最小传播 DP（SOS DP 风格）在\n  O(n·2^n) 内精确求解，避免 O(4^n) 两两比较；\n- 对每个掩码 A，在其补集的 `bestW` 表中 O(1) 取出最小的法定人数 B，遍历\n  全体 A 即得全局最小不相交对；\n- 故障域组合只在权重和层面做可用性判定（O(k)），指数级的集合枚举只对进入\n  报告的有限场景运行；\n- 模拟器是整数虚拟时钟 + 最小堆事件循环；随机源为内置 splitmix64，\n  无系统熵，同种子同输入逐位复现；\n- 测试包内另含一个朴素 O(4^n) 暴力参考实现，对结构化用例与数千个随机\n  权重/阈值组合做交叉校验（见 `internal/quorum/masks_test.go`）。\n\n## 边界与限制\n\n- 穷举上限 20 个节点（内存约每表 4 MiB）；域故障组合数有上限（200000），\n  超出会产生 `scenario_enumeration_truncated` 警告且可用性结论保守；\n- 模拟器验证的是“协议可到达的交错”，随机性只抽样不覆盖全部调度；安全性的\n  权威结论来自穷举分析器，模拟器用于解释与见证；\n- 节点是无状态应答者：模拟的是法定人数交集本身，不包含版本向量/MVCC 等\n  上层机制。\n\n## 请求样例\n\n| 文件 | 场景 |\n|---|---|\n| `examples/01-safe-majority.json` | 3 节点多数派 + 一个零权重观察者（警告） |\n| `examples/02-rw-unsafe.json` | 权重 3/2/1，R=2 W=4：读写不相交，且丢失 az-1 后不可用 |\n| `examples/03-domain-outage.json` | 5 节点 3 域：容忍单域失效的枚举与参考场景 |\n| `examples/04-lossy-network.json` | 20% 丢包 + 25% 重复 + 乱序的 10 次随机运行 |\n| `examples/05-scripted-split.json` | 脚本化“脑裂”：两个写分别只听到不同单节点 |\n\n`examples/output/` 保存了这些请求在本机的实际 JSON {"parentUuid":"1cac5a7e-1686-4f0a-ab28-24bdfd5138ff","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"项目完成。最终验收全部通过。\n\n## 交付总结\n\n在空目录中从零实现了**加权法定人数检查器**（Go，零第三方依赖，纯后端，无前端）。\n\n### 架构\n- `internal/quorum/` — 配置验证器 + 掩码穷举分析器。位掩码枚举全部子集（≤20 节点），用 SOS 风格的子集格 DP 在 O(n·2ⁿ) 内精确求最小不相交读/写、写/写法定人数对；按故障域组合枚举幸存者场景，判定整域失效后的可用性。\n- `internal/sim/` — **确定性离散事件模拟器**：整数虚拟时钟 + 事件最小堆，单进程内模拟节点（无 socket/goroutine/真实集群）；内置 splitmix64 PRNG（同种子逐字节复现），网络策略支持独立丢包、重复（客户端按节点去重）、乱序，或顺序匹配的确定性脚本规则；`failed_domains` 模拟整域宕机。\n- `cmd/quorumcheck/` — `analyze | simulate | all` 三个动作，stdin/stdout JSON 接口；`all` 会把分析器找到的每个最小反例自动编译成脚本化网络的**模拟器见证**真实复现违例。\n\n### 验收项对应\n- **读写 / 写写相交性**：`rw_safe`、`ww_safe` 及最小反例（参与节点最少→总权重最小→掩码兜底）。\n- **小规模穷举作参考**：测试内含朴素 O(4ⁿ) 暴力 oracle，对结构化用例 + 4000 组随机权重/阈值交叉校验，全部一致；另验证 `R+W>W总`、`2W>W总` 定理及等号可分性。\n- **零权重**：警告且规范化排除（永不计入、不出现在集合列表/反例中）；**重复节点 id**：报错并退出码 2；**整域故障**：枚举 + 最小不可用故障组合 + 完美网络下的可用性见证 + 全域宕机参考场景。\n- 交付：源码、README（含 JSON 格式文档）、7 个请求样例及实际输出、3 个测试文件。\n\n### 实测结果（已如实写入 README \"运行记录\"）\n- `go vet` 通过；`go test -race -count=1 ./...` 三包全部 ok；覆盖率 75% / 92.3% / 93.0%。\n- 20 节点穷举 ~0.09s，法定人数精确计数 214957；同请求两次运行输出逐字节相同。\n- **开发中发现并修复的缺陷**：初版重传时清空已响应节点集合却漏清累计权重，单节点跨尝试重复应答会被双计，使安全的 2/3 多数派被误报违例。已改为跨尝试按节点全局去重，新增两个回归测试（60 次高丢包零违例、单节点多次应答永不凑齐）。修复后无未通过项。\n\n未提交 git（你没有要求）；产物都在工作树中，`bin/` 已写入
